# Overview

A FLAG copy-number ladder - 1x, then every 10 copies - placed in the MDA-MB-231
CDS landscape. **MDA-MB-231 only**, same background and gene set as `01_`, `03_`
and `04_`. The rungs are a parameter; see `flag_copies` below.

The appeal of a FLAG ladder is that it should move **length while holding
composition still**. Section 6 measures that instead of assuming it, and the
answer is split, with the figures for the current rungs computed there:

- **GC3 does hold.** It barely moves across the ladder, a few percent of the
  transcriptome's IQR against a length change of roughly half of its IQR. On the
  GC3 axis this really is a pure length series.
- **Total GC does not.** The FLAG epitope is GC-poor (the 1x tag is 40.7% GC
  against NanoLuc's 53.9%), so every copy dilutes the construct's GC, and over a
  long ladder that drift becomes comparable, in distribution units, to the length
  change the ladder exists to produce.

So a long FLAG ladder **confounds length with GC**, and the longer it is the worse
that gets. It is a clean length series with respect to GC3 and wobble-position
effects, and a poor one if total GC is the variable in question. The assertion in
section 6 holds GC3 to that standard and prints the GC drift rather than letting
it pass unnoticed.

**The repeat unit here is the canonical FLAG epitope, DYKDDDDK, tandemly
repeated** - 24 nt per copy, so the ladder is exactly linear. This differs from
`04_`, whose 3x used your three *distinct* repeats (DYKDHDG / DYKDHDI /
DYKDDDDK, 66 nt). Beyond 3 copies there is nothing left to nest, so a uniform unit
is the only way to make a regular ladder, and it keeps every rung comparable. The
codons are still taken from your `flag3x`, never retyped. `04_`'s 3x and a 3x on
this scheme would differ by 6 nt; nothing else here depends on that.

As in `03_`/`04_`, the whole fusion is one ORF measured as one CDS, NanoLuc keeps
its junction + PEST tail, and an ATG is prepended.

# Load Libraries

```{r load_libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(Biostrings)

source(here("code", "cds_reporter_design", "reporter_helpers.R"))
```

```{r params}
lfc_cutoff  <- 0.5
padj_cutoff <- 0.05

# The rungs of the ladder: 1x, then every `flag_step` copies, `n_rungs` in all.
# Both are YAML params, so a step size is a re-knit rather than an edit, and the
# output filenames carry the step so different ladders do not overwrite each
# other. Section 5 reports where each target length is crossed, independently of
# which rungs were chosen.
flag_copies <- c(1, 1 + params$flag_step * seq_len(params$n_rungs - 1))
ladder_tag  <- paste0("step", params$flag_step)

stopifnot(
  "flag_copies must be strictly increasing" = all(diff(flag_copies) > 0),
  "flag_copies must be a uniform ladder after the 1x rung" =
    length(unique(diff(flag_copies))) == 1
)

cat("Ladder:", ladder_tag, "|", params$n_rungs, "rungs\n")

cat("FLAG copy numbers:", paste0(flag_copies, "x", collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("lfc_cutoff =", lfc_cutoff, "| padj_cutoff =", padj_cutoff, "\n")
```

# 1. Import the FLAG Epitope

```{r read_parts}
parts_tbl <- read_excel(here("accessories", "cds seq.xlsx"))
names(parts_tbl)[1] <- "construct"
parts <- parts_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(construct), !is.na(cds)) %>%
  transmute(part = tolower(str_trim(construct)),
            seq  = toupper(gsub("\\s", "", cds)))
pseq <- setNames(parts$seq, parts$part)

needed <- c("flag3x", "p2a", "nanoluc")
stopifnot(
  "A required part is missing from cds seq.xlsx" = all(needed %in% names(pseq)),
  "A part contains non-ACGT characters" = all(!grepl("[^ACGT]", pseq[needed])),
  "A part is not divisible by 3" = all(nchar(pseq[needed]) %% 3 == 0)
)

flag3x <- pseq[["flag3x"]]
FLAG3X_AA <- "DYKDHDGDYKDHDIDYKDDDDK"

# Orientation, asserted the same way as 04_: this row was once pasted as the
# reverse complement, which is 66 nt and in frame and so passes every length and
# composition check while translating to nonsense.
stopifnot(
  "flag3x is not 66 nt" = nchar(flag3x) == 66,
  "flag3x does not encode the canonical 3xFLAG peptide" =
    as.character(translate(DNAString(flag3x))) == FLAG3X_AA,
  "Both orientations encode 3xFLAG: the orientation check is not discriminative" =
    as.character(translate(reverseComplement(DNAString(flag3x)))) != FLAG3X_AA
)
cat("flag3x verified:", nchar(flag3x), "nt ->", FLAG3X_AA, "\n")

# The repeat unit is the third repeat of the supplied sequence, which is the
# canonical FLAG epitope. Taken from the spreadsheet, not written here.
FLAG_UNIT <- substr(flag3x, 43, 66)
stopifnot(
  "The repeat unit is not 24 nt"   = nchar(FLAG_UNIT) == 24,
  "The repeat unit is not DYKDDDDK" =
    as.character(translate(DNAString(FLAG_UNIT))) == "DYKDDDDK"
)
cat("Repeat unit:", FLAG_UNIT, "->",
    as.character(translate(DNAString(FLAG_UNIT))), "(24 nt)\n")
```

# 2. Build the Ladder

```{r build_ladder}
P2A_AA <- "ATNFSLLKQAGDVEENPGP"
stopifnot("The p2a part does not encode the expected 19-aa P2A peptide" =
            as.character(translate(DNAString(pseq[["p2a"]]))) == P2A_AA)

nl <- load_nanoluc_construct()

make_tag <- function(n) paste0("ATG", strrep(FLAG_UNIT, n))
tags    <- set_names(map(flag_copies, make_tag), paste0(flag_copies, "xFLAG"))
fusions <- map(tags, ~ paste0(.x, pseq[["p2a"]], nl$full))
names(fusions) <- paste0(names(tags), "-P2A-NanoLuc")

cat("Fusion ORF validation:\n")
iwalk(fusions, ~ check_orf(.x, .y))

nl_aa_full <- as.character(translate(DNAString(nl$full)))

walk2(fusions, flag_copies, function(f, n) {
  aa <- as.character(translate(DNAString(f)))
  stopifnot(
    "Fusion length is not base + n * 24" =
      nchar(f) == 3 + 24 * n + nchar(pseq[["p2a"]]) + nchar(nl$full),
    # The epitope must appear exactly n times, in frame. A tandem repeat is
    # exactly where an off-by-one or a dropped copy would hide.
    "FLAG epitope copy number does not match the rung" =
      lengths(gregexpr("DYKDDDDK", aa, fixed = TRUE)) == n,
    "P2A peptide not found exactly once in the fusion protein" =
      lengths(gregexpr(P2A_AA, aa, fixed = TRUE)) == 1,
    # A frame slip anywhere upstream changes every downstream residue.
    "Fusion does not end with the full NanoLuc + PEST protein" =
      endsWith(aa, nl_aa_full),
    "NanoLuc portion is not bit-identical to the construct" =
      substr(f, nchar(f) - nchar(nl$full) + 1, nchar(f)) == nl$full
  )
})
cat("All", length(fusions), "rungs: copy number exact, single in-frame P2A,",
    "C-terminal NanoLuc+PEST bit-identical\n")

# The ladder must be exactly linear in copy number.
len <- map_int(fusions, nchar)
stopifnot("Ladder spacing is not 24 nt per FLAG copy" =
            all(diff(len) == 24 * diff(flag_copies)))
cat("Ladder lengths:", paste(len, collapse = " / "), "nt\n")
```

```{r ladder_table}
ref_df <- tibble(
  reporter    = names(fusions),
  flag_copies = flag_copies,
  cds_length  = map_int(fusions, nchar),
  gc_pct      = map_dbl(fusions, orf_gc_pct),
  gc3_pct     = map_dbl(fusions, orf_gc3_pct)
)

stopifnot(
  "Reporter GC% out of range"  = all(ref_df$gc_pct  >= 0 & ref_df$gc_pct  <= 100),
  "Reporter GC3% out of range" = all(ref_df$gc3_pct >= 0 & ref_df$gc3_pct <= 100)
)

print(ref_df %>% mutate(across(c(gc_pct, gc3_pct), ~ round(.x, 1))))

# An ordered series needs an ordered colour ramp, which categorical Okabe-Ito
# cannot express. A purple ramp avoids the two reserved factor hues (#E69F00
# eIF3d, #56B4E9 eIF3e) and the density-curve greys.
ref_plot_df <- ref_df %>%
  mutate(color = colorRampPalette(c("#EBC6DA", "#CC79A7", "#5C2443"))(n()),
         linetype = "solid",
         reporter = factor(reporter, levels = reporter))
```

# 3. MDA-MB-231 Background and Gene Set

```{r load_promotes}
te_hyp <- read_csv(
  here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE)

# Direction check. These files hold the sictrl_vs_si3d coefficient despite the
# filename stating the ratio the other way round, so positive te_lfc = eIF3d
# promotes. EIF3D's own rna_lfc must be strongly positive because the siRNA
# depletes its target.
eif3d_rna <- te_hyp %>% filter(symbol == "EIF3D") %>% pull(rna_lfc)
stopifnot("EIF3D rna_lfc is not strongly positive: contrast direction may be flipped" =
            length(eif3d_rna) == 1 && eif3d_rna > 2)
cat("Direction check - EIF3D rna_lfc:", round(eif3d_rna, 2), "\n")

promotes <- te_hyp %>%
  filter(te_lfc > lfc_cutoff, te_padj < padj_cutoff) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))
stopifnot("Expected 1604 eIF3d hypoxia-promoted genes" = nrow(promotes) == 1604)
cat("eIF3d hypoxia-promoted genes:", nrow(promotes), "\n")
```

```{r transcripts}
fm <- readRDS(here("output", "predictive_modeling",
                   "feature_matrix_external_stability.rds"))
tx_all      <- fm %>% dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, gene_id_clean, symbol)
tx_promotes <- tx_all %>% filter(gene_id_clean %in% promotes$gene_id_clean)

missing_gene_ids <- promotes$gene_id_clean[
  !promotes$gene_id_clean %in% tx_all$gene_id_clean]

tx_map <- read_tsv(
  here("accessories", "human", "tx2gene_hs_dm_v49_r111.tsv.gz"),
  col_names = c("transcript_id", "gene_id"), col_types = "cc") %>%
  filter(str_starts(transcript_id, "ENST")) %>%
  transmute(transcript_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", transcript_id),
            gene_id_clean       = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))

hyp_samples <- c("NM2025_0094", "NM2025_0095", "NM2025_0096")
hyp_files   <- setNames(
  file.path(here("2025_MDAcells_riboseq", "salmon"), hyp_samples, "quant.sf.gz"),
  hyp_samples)
stopifnot("Hypoxia siCTRL quant files missing" = all(file.exists(hyp_files)))

extra_tx_df <- map_dfr(names(hyp_files), function(s) {
  read_tsv(hyp_files[[s]], col_types = "cdddd",
           col_names = c("Name", "Length", "EffectiveLength", "TPM", "NumReads"),
           skip = 1) %>% dplyr::select(Name, TPM)
}) %>%
  group_by(Name) %>% summarise(mean_tpm = mean(TPM), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(transcript_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", Name)) %>%
  inner_join(tx_map, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>%
  filter(gene_id_clean %in% missing_gene_ids, mean_tpm > 0) %>%
  group_by(gene_id_clean) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(mean_tpm, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(promotes %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol) %>% distinct(),
            by = "gene_id_clean") %>%
  dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, gene_id_clean, symbol)

tx_promotes <- bind_rows(tx_promotes, extra_tx_df)
cat("Promoted genes with a transcript:", nrow(tx_promotes), "\n")
```

```{r build_metrics}
metrics_all <- build_cds_metrics(
  here("accessories", "human", "txdb.gencode49.sqlite"))

expressed <- tx_all %>%
  inner_join(metrics_all, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>% filter(cds_length > 0)
promoted <- tx_promotes %>%
  inner_join(metrics_all, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>% filter(cds_length > 0)

cat("Expressed transcriptome - valid CDS:", nrow(expressed), "\n")
cat("eIF3d promoted        - valid CDS:", nrow(promoted), "\n")

stopifnot(
  "GC% out of range"  = all(expressed$gc_pct  >= 0 & expressed$gc_pct  <= 100),
  "GC3% out of range" = all(expressed$gc3_pct >= 0 & expressed$gc3_pct <= 100),
  "GC3 median not in expected range [40, 65]" =
    between(median(expressed$gc3_pct), 40, 65)
)

actb <- expressed %>% filter(symbol == "ACTB") %>% dplyr::slice(1)
if (nrow(actb) == 1) {
  stopifnot("ACTB CDS GC% outside expected 50-70%" = between(actb$gc_pct, 50, 70))
  cat("ACTB CDS GC%:", round(actb$gc_pct, 2), "\n")
}
```

# 5. Where Each Rung Lands

```{r percentiles}
pct_tbl <- reporter_percentiles(expressed, promoted, ref_df)

len_pct <- pct_tbl %>%
  filter(metric == "cds_length") %>%
  dplyr::select(reporter, cds_length = reporter_value,
                pct_expressed, pct_promoted)
print(len_pct)

stopifnot("Percentiles must lie in [0, 100]" =
            all(pct_tbl$pct_expressed >= 0 & pct_tbl$pct_expressed <= 100 &
                pct_tbl$pct_promoted  >= 0 & pct_tbl$pct_promoted  <= 100))

write_csv(pct_tbl,
          here("output", "cds_reporter_design",
               paste0("05_flag_ladder_percentiles_vs_231_", ladder_tag, ".csv")))
cat("Exported: 05_flag_ladder_percentiles_vs_231_", ladder_tag, ".csv\n", sep = "")
```

The design question a ladder answers is how many copies it takes to reach a given
part of the distribution. Solved directly from the 24 nt-per-copy spacing rather
than read off the panel.

```{r copies_to_reach}
base_len <- 3 + nchar(pseq[["p2a"]]) + nchar(nl$full)   # ATG + P2A + NanoLuc
stopifnot("Base length does not match the 1x rung" =
            base_len + 24 == ref_df$cds_length[ref_df$flag_copies == 1])

targets <- tribble(
  ~target,                          ~value,
  "eIF3d promoted median",          median(promoted$cds_length),
  "expressed transcriptome median", median(expressed$cds_length),
  "eIF3d promoted 75th pct",        quantile(promoted$cds_length, 0.75),
  "expressed 75th pct",             quantile(expressed$cds_length, 0.75)
) %>%
  mutate(copies_needed = ceiling((value - base_len) / 24),
         length_at_that_copy = base_len + 24 * copies_needed,
         value = round(value))

print(targets)

write_csv(targets,
          here("output", "cds_reporter_design",
               "05_flag_copies_to_reach_targets.csv"))
cat("Exported: output/cds_reporter_design/05_flag_copies_to_reach_targets.csv\n")
```

# 6. Does the Ladder Actually Hold Composition Still?

The premise is that FLAG copies move length without moving composition. That is
a claim about these specific codons, so it is measured rather than assumed - and
it holds for GC3 but **not** for total GC, because the FLAG epitope is GC-poor.

```{r composition_drift}
drift <- ref_df %>%
  mutate(d_gc  = gc_pct  - gc_pct[flag_copies == 1],
         d_gc3 = gc3_pct - gc3_pct[flag_copies == 1]) %>%
  dplyr::select(flag_copies, cds_length, gc_pct, d_gc, gc3_pct, d_gc3) %>%
  mutate(across(c(gc_pct, d_gc, gc3_pct, d_gc3), ~ round(.x, 2)))
print(drift)

iqr_gc  <- IQR(expressed$gc_pct)
iqr_gc3 <- IQR(expressed$gc3_pct)
cat(sprintf("\nAcross the whole ladder: GC moves %.2f points (%.1f%% of the expressed IQR, %.1f)\n",
            diff(range(ref_df$gc_pct)),
            100 * diff(range(ref_df$gc_pct)) / iqr_gc, iqr_gc))
cat(sprintf("                        GC3 moves %.2f points (%.1f%% of the expressed IQR, %.1f)\n",
            diff(range(ref_df$gc3_pct)),
            100 * diff(range(ref_df$gc3_pct)) / iqr_gc3, iqr_gc3))
cat(sprintf("                        length moves %d nt (%.0f%% of the expressed IQR, %.0f)\n",
            diff(range(ref_df$cds_length)),
            100 * diff(range(ref_df$cds_length)) / IQR(expressed$cds_length),
            IQR(expressed$cds_length)))

# In IQR units, how each axis moves across the ladder.
len_share <- diff(range(ref_df$cds_length)) / IQR(expressed$cds_length)
gc3_share <- diff(range(ref_df$gc3_pct))    / iqr_gc3
gc_share  <- diff(range(ref_df$gc_pct))     / iqr_gc

stopifnot("GC3 drift is not small relative to the length change: not a clean length ladder on GC3" =
            gc3_share < len_share / 5)
cat(sprintf("\nIn IQR units: length %.3f | GC3 %.3f | GC %.3f\n",
            len_share, gc3_share, gc_share))
cat("GC3 drift is >5x smaller than the length change: clean on the GC3 axis.\n")

# GC is a different story, and the point is to surface it, not to fail on it.
# FLAG is GC-poor, so copies dilute GC nearly as fast, in distribution units, as
# they extend length. A ladder used to test a length effect would confound it
# with GC unless that is controlled for.
if (gc_share > len_share / 5) {
  cat(sprintf("WARNING: GC drifts %.2f points (%.0f%% of the GC IQR) across the ladder,\n",
              diff(range(ref_df$gc_pct)), 100 * gc_share))
  cat(sprintf("         against a length change of %.0f%% of the length IQR.\n",
              100 * len_share))
  cat("         This ladder confounds length with GC. It is a length series with\n")
  cat("         respect to GC3 only.\n")
}
```

```{r export_sequences}
seq_out <- tibble(
  reporter = names(fusions),
  flag_copies = flag_copies,
  length_nt_stop_free = map_int(fusions, nchar),
  gc_pct  = round(map_dbl(fusions, orf_gc_pct), 3),
  gc3_pct = round(map_dbl(fusions, orf_gc3_pct), 3),
  bases   = unlist(fusions, use.names = FALSE)
)
write_csv(seq_out,
          here("output", "cds_reporter_design",
               paste0("05_flag_ladder_assembled_sequences_", ladder_tag, ".csv")))
cat("Exported: 05_flag_ladder_assembled_sequences_", ladder_tag, ".csv\n", sep = "")
```

# 7. Summary

```{r summary}
cat("=== FLAG copy-number ladder vs MDA-MB-231 ===\n\n")
cat("Unit: DYKDDDDK, 24 nt, tandem. Base (ATG + P2A + NanoLuc+PEST):",
    base_len, "nt\n\n")

for (i in seq_len(nrow(ref_df))) {
  cat(sprintf("%3dx FLAG  %5d nt (%3.0f codons)  GC %.1f%%  GC3 %.1f%%  ->  %4.1f pct expressed, %4.1f pct promoted\n",
              ref_df$flag_copies[i], ref_df$cds_length[i],
              ref_df$cds_length[i] / 3, ref_df$gc_pct[i], ref_df$gc3_pct[i],
              len_pct$pct_expressed[i], len_pct$pct_promoted[i]))
}

cat(sprintf("\nMDA-MB-231 medians: all expressed %.0f nt | promoted %.0f nt\n",
            median(expressed$cds_length), median(promoted$cds_length)))

cat("\nCopies needed to reach:\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(targets))) {
  cat(sprintf("  %-32s %5.0f nt  ->  %3d copies (%d nt)\n",
              targets$target[i], targets$value[i],
              targets$copies_needed[i], targets$length_at_that_copy[i]))
}
```
